candidates.title: [Bug] Reasoning parser splits on first occurrence of closing think tag: quoted </think> inside reasoning truncates reasoning_content and leaks the rest of the CoT into content
candidates.snippet: ### Describe the bug  When a reasoning model quotes the literal string `</think>` inside its own chain-of-thought (e.g. because the task itself involves think-tag handling), the reasoning parser treats that quoted occurrence as the end-of-reasoning delimiter. Everything after it — the rest of the reasoning, the model's *real* closing tag, and the final answer — is routed into `content`. candidates.title: [RFC] Add NPU RLHF Lifecycle Tests
candidates.snippet: ## Summary  NPU tests validate the RL data plane (indexer topk, logprobs, reward scores) but have no coverage for the lifecycle APIs an RL trainer depends on: release/resume memory occupation, weight refit, and pause/continue. A broken release or refit does not fail a model test — it silently corrupts a training run.
